jobs.title: Associate Product Marketing Director
jobs.description:
About Us
Think about your last hotel stay. Did you skip the front desk line with mobile check-in? Message the staff for extra pillows? Order a late-night snack with a tap on your phone? Then you’ve likely run into Canary in the wild.
Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.
We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly $200M raised to date.
Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company, and swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards, including Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform, and the Hotelier’s Choice Award. We’re scaling our team to bring innovation to life faster than ever.
We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. We value rigor and velocity in equal measure: high standards, fast pace, real ownership. If that's the environment you're looking for, this is the place for you.
Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.

 


About the Role
We're looking for a seasoned Associate Product Marketing Director to run and scale the impact of product marketing across Canary. You'll manage an existing team of top PMMs and act as the connective tissue between product, sales, and marketing. You will define Canary’s unique place in the hospitality market as the leader in agentic AI solutions for guest and staff management.
This is not a coordinator role. It’s also not a pure strategy role. You'll set the positioning and messaging framework for the entire platform, own pricing and packaging strategy, and make Canary’s value clear and compelling for individual hotels as well as world-class brands. You'll work directly with the Head of Brand Marketing and the rest of the leadership team to influence strategy and prioritize roadmap.

What You’ll Do
- Team leadership.  Manage, coach, and develop a team of PMMs (currently 3). Build the function's operating model and hold a high bar on quality and speed of execution. Foster a culture of continuous investment in individuals and the function as a whole rooted in ongoing feedback and improvements that makes the team better every quarter.

- Positioning and messaging.  Define and maintain Canary's platform and product-level positioning. Translate complex AI capabilities into clear, differentiated value props for hotel operators — from global enterprise brands to independent properties.

- Storytelling and narrative.  Build the overarching platform narrative and ensure it holds across every touchpoint — the website, sales decks, event keynotes, analyst briefings, and customer conversations. Differentiate Canary’s narrative from the competitive landscape.

- Product launches.  Own the GTM process end to end — launch strategy, tiering, internal collaboration, and external amplification.

- Product suite performance.  Continuous analytics and monitoring on product performance and opportunities for improvement from pipeline through churn reduction.

- Market intelligence.  Maintain a deep, current read on the hospitality tech competitive landscape, buyer dynamics, and how the AI wave is reshaping the category.
What We’re Looking For
- 8+ years in product marketing, with at least 2–3 years managing and developing a PMM team.

- Experience scaling the impact of a PMM function — not just inheriting one.

- Deep expertise in pricing and packaging strategy, ideally in a SaaS context with a multi-product portfolio.

- Strong positioning and messaging chops — you've taken complex products to market and made them simple and compelling.

- Experience with product launches from concept through post-launch measurement; you've run launches across multiple tiers and know how to calibrate the machine.

- A storyteller at heart — you write and communicate with precision and can shift register from a hotel GM to a C-suite executive to an analyst.

- Analytically rigorous — you use data to make decisions, build business cases, and keep customer value and ROI as central to the product story.

- Background in  B2B SaaS AI  or  hospitality technology  strongly preferred; candidates who've worked in vertically focused SaaS (especially in industries with complex, multi-segment buyer dynamics) will stand out.

- Based in New York City; comfortable in a hybrid environment (3 days / week in office)
Compensation
Target cash compensation ranges from $190,000 – $230,000 , including a fixed annual salary and a performance-based bonus paid monthly.

This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval.

Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's skill level, experience, and specific work location.
Perks & Benefits
We work hard to make Canary a fun, rewarding, and high-energy place to work. Here’s how we take care of our flock:
Time Off
Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to truly rest and recharge.
Holidays + Canary Days: Standard holidays plus monthly company-wide days off for a guaranteed long weekend.
Birthday Holiday: A dedicated day off to celebrate you!
Travel & Office Flexibility
Office Exchange: A travel stipend to visit the team in person at our SF, NY, or Dallas hubs.
Canary Hotel Experience: Staying at a Canary hotel? We’ve got you covered with a credit toward your stay.
Preferred Hotels Discount: Enjoy a minimum 30% off the best available rate at select partner hotels globally.
Growth & Community
Self Improvement Club: A monthly budget to help you smash your personal goals.
Professional Development: Level up your career with a dedicated learning stipend to fuel your skills and cross-functional connection.
Referral Program: Help us grow the flock and score a cash bonus for successful hires.
 
Canary Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote talent regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other protected characteristic.

We're looking for a Director of Product to own our flagship offering: the Digital Guest Journey. This role is pivotal in shaping the way travelers around the world interact with hotels in the digital age. As Director of Product, you'll own the roadmap, evolution, and success of the Digital Guest Journey — setting the vision, making the hard calls, and ensuring the product consistently exceeds the expectations of our top partners while delighting millions of travelers worldwide.

- Own the product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the Digital Guest Journey — defining what gets built, what doesn't, and why.

- Maintain direct, ongoing relationships with hotel operators and enterprise clients to shorten feedback loops and sharpen prioritization between formal research cycles.

- Lead technical conversations with engineering and enterprise clients with precision, including system architecture, integration dependencies, and trade-offs.

- Drive execution and alignment across engineering, sales, customer success, and design around shared outcomes.

- 10+ years of product management experience, with at least 2–3 years in a senior or director-level PM role at an enterprise SaaS company.

- A track record of proactively identifying high-impact problems — not just executing on a roadmap handed to you.

- The ability to narrate a product decision in business terms: what metric moved, what it meant for revenue, margin, or retention, and how you knew it mattered.

- Technical depth to explain how your product works under the hood — not just what it does — and lead conversations with engineers and enterprise clients at the right level of detail.

About the Role
Canary Technologies is hiring a Head of Product Design to own the design system, information hierarchy, and interaction principles that govern every surface of Canary's platform — for human users and AI agents alike.
Most design system roles are about consistency for humans. This one is about building the design language that AI agents obey. You're not just making a dashboard pretty — you're defining the rules of interaction for a platform where AI is increasingly the operator. That's a new kind of design leadership, and we want someone who sees it that way.
Canary's product surface is expanding fast across checkin, messaging, upsells, voice, and more. We need someone obsessive about consistency, hierarchy, and systematic design who can establish principles that scale — not just across screens, but across a future where AI agents are primary users of our interfaces. The design system you build won't just guide human designers; it will be the contract that AI follows.

What You’ll Do
- Define and enforce a unified design system across all Canary product surfaces — components, spacing, typography, color, layout patterns, and page-level templates

- Establish clear information hierarchy standards so every page communicates priority, status, and action with zero ambiguity

- Build design principles rigid enough to be programmatically enforced and flexible enough to serve diverse hospitality workflows

- Create specifications precise enough that AI coding agents can generate UI that meets your bar without human review

- Audit existing surfaces ruthlessly and drive convergence toward a single coherent system

- Partner closely with engineering and product to make the design system the source of truth — not a side artifact

- Think deeply about how AI agents (voice, chat, autonomous) interact with and present Canary's UI, and design for that as a first-class use case
What We’re Looking For
- 8+ years in Product Design with 3+ years leading teams directly. Experience operating in B2B or B2B2C SaaS preferred.

- Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end systems thinking, exceptional product craft, and shipped work at scale across web and mobile is essential.

- Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain diverse design talent. Strength in feedback, coaching, and org-building.

- Strong partner to Product and Engineering. Comfortable in ambiguity, rapid iteration, and enterprise constraints.

- You are inspired by companies like Rippling, Linear, or Stripe where systematic design creates product clarity

- Fluency in design systems, accessibility, UX research methods, and experimentation. Familiarity with analytics tools.

- Excited by the idea that your design system becomes the rulebook for AI agents building and operating UI

- Meticulous, opinionated, and able to hold the line on standards while moving fast

- Comfortable being both hands-on (Figma, tokens, specs) and strategic (principles, governance, cross-pod alignment)
Compensation
Target cash compensation ranges from $250,000-$290,000 , including a fixed annual salary and a performance-based bonus paid quarterly.

This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval.

Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's skill level, experience, and specific work location.

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to lead our Connectivity and Integrations product area with a focus on enabling Canary to expand its addressable market and to pursue new integrations that unlock new staff-facing and guest-facing workflows. This is a key strategic role that will work across the product team and cross-functionally with our sales, customer success, and implementations teams. As Product Lead over our Connectivity team, you will have a direct impact in charting the growth trajectory for Canary and supporting new product initiatives.

What You’ll Do
- Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for Canary's third-party integrations across reservation platforms, payment gateways, and other adjacent hospitality integrations.

- Serve as the platform product manager for integrations across all Canary products, defining shared frameworks and reusable APIs so product teams can connect to any partner system without rebuilding from scratch.

- Prioritize the integration roadmap based on customer demand, enterprise brand requirements, and revenue impact.

- Own the relationships with integration partners including technical scoping, testing + certification, and managing each partnership across the integration lifecycle.

- Partner with product teams to ensure integrations meet each product's needs while keeping the underlying platform consistent and maintainable.

- Define and track integration health metrics - data accuracy, sync reliability, uptime, latency, and coverage - surfacing actionable improvements before customers feel the impact.

- Represent the integrations roadmap to enterprise customers, sales, and customer success translating technical constraints into clear commitments and realistic timelines.

- 6+ years in product management, including experience owning platform, API, or integration products.

- Hands-on experience with third-party system integrations — ideally PMS, CRS, or payment gateways/processors, or comparable B2B ecosystems (fintech rails, ERP, EHR, or similar).

- Enough technical depth to go deep with engineers on APIs, webhooks, data modeling, authentication, and integration architecture — and to ask the right questions.

- A track record as a platform PM serving multiple internal product teams as your customers, balancing competing needs against a single coherent platform vision.

- Experience managing external vendor and partner relationships, including technical scoping and certification processes.

- Strong analytical skills and comfort connecting integration reliability and coverage to customer and business outcomes.

- Ability to operate with ambiguity and drive alignment across teams without direct authority.

You'll build new mobile products from 0 → 1, evolve what already exists, and stay close enough to customers to know what's working before the data catches up. If you're energized by owning something end-to-end and want your work to show up in the hands of millions of hotel guests, let's talk.

- A track record of shipping high-quality mobile experiences with measurable business impact — not just shipping features.

Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.
We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly $200M raised to date.
Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company, and swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards, including Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform, and the Hotelier’s Choice Award. We’re scaling our team to bring innovation to life faster than ever.
We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. We value rigor and velocity in equal measure: high standards, fast pace, real ownership. If that's the environment you're looking for, this is the place for you.
Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.

 


About the Role
We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling narratives that compel buyers and enable sales teams. You'll own product areas and strategic go-to-market initiatives end to end, working in close collaboration with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Support teams.
This is a highly cross-functional and strategic role that blends storytelling, market insight, go-to-market strategy and execution to fuel growth and improve conversions.
 

What You’ll Do
- Messaging and Positioning: Develop and maintain product-level messaging and positioning. Translate what Canary builds into language that resonates with specific personas, tailoring it to SMB, mid-market, and enterprise audiences.

- Sales Assets: Build the sales and marketing assets that clearly communicates Canary’s value and differentiation that resonates for each stage of the marketing funnel. Understand from the Sales and Customer Support teams what’s working and what improvements are needed to improve how we communicate with customers and prospects.

- Storytelling and Content: Craft engaging and persuasive presentations including sales decks, webinars, and presentations in collaboration with growth, partner, and content marketers.

- Market & Competitive Intelligence: Maintain a working understanding of the competitive landscape in your product areas. Know how competitors position, what claims they make, and where Canary wins and loses.

- Data and Analysis: Utilize data to measure the success of go-to-market initiatives, marketing campaigns, and product adoption, reporting on key metrics and providing actionable insights for optimization.
What We’re Looking For
- +5 years of product marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment

- Strong communicator, both internally as well as to the market. You are a strong writer and visual storyteller able to communicate complex topics in a simple, digestible way.

- Comfort working with data and deriving actionable insights — you measure the impact of your work and use that to make better decisions

- Experience bringing new products to market

- A high quality bar for external assets — you know what "ship-ready" looks like and won't submit something half-finished

- Strong cross-functional instincts — you work well with product, sales, and design without needing heavy coordination overhead; you’re able to effectively influence without direct authority

- Preferred: Management consulting experience, hospitality and/or travel tech experience, and multi-product, platform, and AI products experience.
Perks & Benefits
We work hard to make Canary a fun, rewarding, and high-energy place to work. Here’s how we take care of our flock:
Time Off
Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to truly rest and recharge.
Holidays + Canary Days: Standard holidays plus monthly company-wide days off for a guaranteed long weekend.
Birthday Holiday: A dedicated day off to celebrate you!
Travel & Office Flexibility
Office Exchange: A travel stipend to visit the team in person at our SF, NY, or Dallas hubs.
Canary Hotel Experience: Staying at a Canary hotel? We’ve got you covered with a credit toward your stay.
Preferred Hotels Discount: Enjoy a minimum 30% off the best available rate at select partner hotels globally.
Growth & Community
Self Improvement Club: A monthly budget to help you smash your personal goals.
Professional Development: Level up your career with a dedicated learning stipend to fuel your skills and cross-functional connection.
Referral Program: Help us grow the flock and score a cash bonus for successful hires.
 
Canary Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote talent regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other protected characteristic.

About the Role
We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager who operates at the intersection of strategic thinking and polished execution. You'll own product areas and strategic go-to-market initiatives end to end, working in close collaboration with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Support teams.
You can build a messaging framework and then write the one-pager that makes it feel obvious to a skeptical buyer. You’ve developed pricing and packaging for new products based on data analytics and first principles. You've built and delivered webinars and presentations that people actually attend and remember. You know what "good" looks like at every altitude — from a competitive positioning brief to a leave-behind a sales rep hands across a conference table.
This is a highly cross-functional and strategic role that blends storytelling, market insight, go-to-market strategy and execution to fuel growth and improve conversions.
 

What You’ll Do
- Product Launches: Define the go-to-market strategy for new products and coordinate cross-functionally to execute product launches. Own pipeline generation, conversations, deal velocity, and revenue outcomes for new product launches.

- Pricing and Packaging: Lead pricing strategy and packaging architecture for your assigned product areas, in close partnership with Product Marketing leadership, Product Managers, and Sales team. You'll translate business goals and buyer behavior into pricing structures that are easy to sell, hard to walk away from, and financially sound.

- Platform and Product Positioning: Develop the positioning frameworks that define how Canary's products compete and how they fit together. Ground your positioning in real buyer psychology and the competitive landscape. Hold the standard for messaging quality across marketing and sales activities for your product areas.

- Narrative Development and Storytelling: Own the stories Canary tells externally about the products in your portfolio. This means executive keynote narratives, analyst briefings, launch messaging, and more. Possess and maintain a high bar for written, visual, and verbal storytelling.

- Analytics and Commercial Impact: Analyze sales and product data to generate insights as well as action plans to improve sales performance. Identify customer metrics that convey the benefits of your solutions and proliferate success stories through well designed and executed campaigns, in partnership with Growth and Content Marketing teams.

- Cross-Functional Influence: Work across product, sales, finance, customer success, and executive leadership to align on strategy, put plans into action, and learn from outcomes. Master executing cross-functionally with influence rather than direct authority.

- Customer Insights: Generate insights from customer conversations that influence how to improve conversions, shapes product strategy, and inspires content and asset development for your suite of solutions.
What We’re Looking For
- +8 years of product marketing experience in a B2B SaaS and/or AI environment

- Experience developing effective and commercially sound pricing and packaging for a multi-product SaaS portfolio

- A portfolio of external storytelling you're proud of: webinars, executive presentations, launch narratives, or analyst content that drove real outcomes

- Strong analytical ability — you can work with pricing models, win/loss data, and market research to build a credible point of view, then translate that into external messaging without losing nuance

- High agency and ability to navigate ambiguity. You take ownership of defining high-leverage initiatives, you develop the approach, and you put it into action.

- Proven track record in product positioning. You've taken complex or technical products to market and made them resonate with non-technical buyers

- Experience in hospitality tech, travel, or vertical SaaS is a meaningful differentiator — Canary's buyers are a specific kind of operator and the learning curve is real

- A genuine high quality bar — for your own work, for the assets that tout your product areas, and for the team around you

- Preferred: Management consulting or related experience, MBA preferred.
Compensation
Target cash compensation ranges from $165,000 - $200,000, including a fixed annual salary and a performance-based bonus paid monthly.

This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval.

Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's skill level, experience, and specific work location.
Perks & Benefits
We work hard to make Canary a fun, rewarding, and high-energy place to work. Here’s how we take care of our flock:
Time Off
Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to truly rest and recharge.
Holidays + Canary Days: Standard holidays plus monthly company-wide days off for a guaranteed long weekend.
Birthday Holiday: A dedicated day off to celebrate you!
Travel & Office Flexibility

Preferred Hotels Discount: Enjoy a minimum 30% off the best available rate at select partner hotels globally.
